meaning: Permanent launchers read this file, health-check the newest app, and open it inside the same Home Screen app. v24 wraps v21 and force-injects a visible Phase 1 Source Intake panel into the Private Window for local/private staging, marker verification, acceptance gating, body-chain status, manifest-alignment blocking, support-object separation, field-family routing, receipts, and private backup. v22 remains last_good fallback. This pointer change enables Home Screen testing only; it does not prove hooks validated, real app proof, source bodies app-accepted, full transfer, current-clean, frozen, or best-in-world.
